assets.musical_note: eighth-note root/fifth/octave ostinato on Dm | Bb | C | A at 96 BPM with a sub root
assets.role: driving low ostinato; the always-present floor of the engaged state

assets.musical_note: pitch-dropping low body on every beat, band-limited noise snap on 2 and 4, off-beat ticks, fill into the loop
assets.role: synthetic percussion; the pulse of the engaged state

assets.musical_note: close-voiced Dm (D4-F4-A4) | Bb (D4-F4-Bb4) | C (E4-G4-C5) | A (E4-A4-C#5) swells
assets.role: sustained brass-like upper voicing; only brought in against several hostiles

assets.musical_note: A major pickup (A3-C#4-E4) into a held D major (D3-A3-D4-F#4-A4-D5), a Picardy landing
assets.role: one-shot victory stinger when an encounter is cleared

assets.musical_note: descending D4-C4-Bb3-A3 over a fading D2 pedal, ending on a bare D minor
assets.role: subdued one-shot failure stinger when an encounter is lost

content_note: The progression, tempo, voicing, percussion and stingers are project-original modern composition. No surviving source authenticates any music for the original Keth Shipyards, and nothing here is presented as recovered or authentic Keth audio.

format_contract.stems: looped forward, loop_begin_frame 0 to the final frame
format_contract.stingers: one-shot, not looped, ending in silence

mix_contract.runtime_gain_note: the runtime layer applies per-stem trim on the Music bus; the failure stinger is authored 6 dB under the victory stinger so a loss is subdued rather than loud

musical_contract.mode: D natural minor (Aeolian); the V chord is A major and the victory lands on D major
musical_contract.seamlessness: every stem is rendered into a loop-length buffer with every tail wrapped across the join, so each stem is periodic by construction; all stems share one length and the runtime starts them together so they stay sample-locked.
musical_contract.shared_key_note: all combat material sits in the calm beds' D natural minor at A4 = 440 Hz, so entering and leaving combat changes energy rather than key.
musical_contract.tempo_note: four times the surface bed's 24 BPM pulse

runtime_intent: adaptive combat layer: three sample-locked stems cross-faded over the ducked calm bed while an encounter is live, a victory or failure stinger when it ends, then a hold before the prior bed returns
